eligibility.quote: Error arises because kobuki.urdf.xacro just defines a component tag `<kobuki/>` that can be used by other xacros (e.g. turtlebot). I've added a kobuki standalone xacro there now.
eligibility.reason: E1 and E4: the maintainer reproduces robot_state_publisher's rejection. E2: kobuki_description supplies an incomplete expanded model to a separately deployed consumer. The fix adds a model that actually instantiates the macro, not merely a deployment name binding. E3: PAIR through robot_description.

failed_conditions.quote: [ERROR] [1356608164.609420111]: No link elements found in urdf file
failed_conditions.reason: The failed requirement is the structural completeness of a robot model, not component order, byte order, handedness, or value encoding. robot_description is the affected parameter.

loudness.quote: [ERROR] [1356608164.610010689]: Failed to extract kdl tree from xml robot description

resolution.reason: The committed standalone model instantiates the component. The thread does not demonstrate the resolved pair with both units identified by revision; recommended is appropriate.

notes: The parser and KDL errors are consequences of the same missing-model-content condition, not additional independent conditions.
